d: Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The role encompasses executive leadership and oversight of Data Center Operations, Critical Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) Infrastructure, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability, ensuring integrated governance, operational resilience, and consistent performance across all markets.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.
q: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.

Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
Proven track record of leading large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
Solid experience managing hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.

Strong technical expertise in mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.

Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.

Proven ability to manage operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations , demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and effective decision-making under pressure.
Strong commercial and financial acumen , including operational budgeting, cost optimization, asset management, and vendor performance management.
Demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams, strengthen operational governance, and scale operations in a growing, multi-market business environment.
Exposure to AI infrastructure, high-density computing, GPU environments, and advanced cooling technologies is highly desirable.
r: li

Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
li

Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations: Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
li

Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure: Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
li

Executive Oversight of Operational Functions: Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
li

Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance: Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
li

Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management: Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
li

Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability: Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
li

Leadership, Organization & Talent Development: Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

d: As a Guest Services Officer, you will be the first point of contact for guests, delivering exceptional service and creating memorable experiences that reflect the luxury standards of Grand Hyatt Doha. Key responsibilities include:
Welcome and assist guests during check-in, check-out, and throughout their stay.
Address guest inquiries, requests, and concerns in a professional and timely manner.
Promote hotel facilities, services, and local attractions.
Coordinate with other departments to ensure seamless guest experiences.
Maintain accurate guest records and process payments as required.
Uphold Hyatt brand standards and contribute to guest satisfaction goals.
q: Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management or a related field preferred.
0-2 years of experience in hospitality, customer service, or hotel operations.
Strong customer-focused mindset with a professional appearance and demeanor.
Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and holidays.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and hotel property management systems is an advantage.
Fluent in English; additional language skills are a plus.
Preferably candidates with experience in hotel operational departments.

d: We are Pramac, a Generac Company, leading the evolution to more resilient, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.

Established in 1966, we have always evolved, expanding our product portfolio and becoming the global benchmark for the production of generators and warehouse material handling equipment. Our diverse business lines ensure the company is a leading player in a wide variety of global markets.

We are looking for a Service Supervisor who will be responsible for assisting internal and external customers, providing technical training, troubleshooting, issue resolution, repair, and sales support.
q: 4+ years related experience in the role
Customer service and support experience in industrial equipment or similar industries
Excellent troubleshooting skills, ability to make independent decisions and work with minimal supervision.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to present technical training content in a group setting.
